title: Require Public Domain Surfaces In Recipes And Maps
forbids: recipe or map source importing domain code outside the aggregate contract, runtime router, model atoms or policy, and module-owned artifact catalogs
why: Recipes compose a domain through its aggregate contract and router, consume immutable products from their semantic module, and read named vocabulary from the nearest model owner. They do not reach through a module into operations, rules, or private implementations.
remediate: Import the aggregate contract from the domain index, runtime composition from its router surface, shared vocabulary from the nearest model/atoms or model/policy owner, and immutable products from the exact modules/<module>/artifacts catalog. Use the package's public domain entrypoint when one exists; otherwise use a direct relative path to the same finite owner. Move any needed private operation behavior behind one of those public owners instead of deep-importing it.
message: Recipe and map source may import domain code only through the root contract/router, nearest model atoms or policy, and module artifact catalogs.
